​

​​​Seizo ONOE​​

D​irector of the ITU Telecommunication Standardization Bureau

​
​Seizo Onoe took office as Director of ITU's Telecommunication Standardization Bureau (TSB) on 1 January 2023. He aims to promote open and inclusive standardization for the numerous, increasingly interconnected systems and technologies that drive today's world, aligning international technical standards with sustainable development. ​

My Vision

​​Value of Standardization: Standardization becomes truly valuable and meaningful only when the standards are widely spread.

My Vision and Goals: To achieve universal meaningful connectivity and sustainable digital transformation through standardization.
